headline: Notability finally arrives on Android, offering a digital whiteboard
summary: After 16 years of iOS exclusivity, the popular note-taking app Notability has launched on Android, providing a digital canvas for ideation and organization.
details: Notability, a long-standing favorite for note-taking and ideation on Apple devices, has officially launched on Android. This marks the end of its 16-year exclusivity to iOS, iPadOS, and macOS since its original debut in 2010.

The app's arrival on Android aims to provide users with a digital whiteboard experience, fulfilling a need for a flexible space to brainstorm, draw, and organize thoughts without the clutter of traditional productivity apps.

Upon opening, Notability presents a minimalist interface with soft grays and off-whites, designed to minimize distractions and facilitate clear thinking. Users have the freedom to start notes anywhere on the blank page.

The app supports freehand drawing, image insertion, and text input, with tools for alignment and formatting. A unique feature allows users to scroll with a single finger in pen mode by tapping a hand icon, preventing accidental ink marks.

Notability also includes robust voice recording capabilities with clear audio playback and adjustable speeds (1x, 1.5x, 2x). AI-powered transcription is available through the Learn menu, further enhancing its utility for information dumping and idea capture.
Collaboration features are built-in, allowing users to share mood boards and notes with teams, which is particularly useful for creative projects like character and world-building in animation.
Projects can be organized using a folder system to keep different universes or ideas separate. The app also offers version histories and customizable templates accessible via a three-dot menu.
The free app entered beta on Android in April 2026 and was released on Google Play in early August 2026.
